draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 31st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 35 at WR. He went 20th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Harry Douglas. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (84th percentile), vertical jump (84th percentile), broad jump (98th percentile). College production: 984 receiving yards in 2020, 9th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 35 career games and 10 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 3 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2024.
